import math

pw = next(x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify')['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists in library
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Compute durations
rows=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pl_id=p['playlist_id']
    detailed=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token)
    songs=detailed.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    total_minutes=total_seconds/60.0
    rows.append((total_minutes, pl_id, detailed.get('title'), len(songs), total_seconds))

rows_sorted=sorted(rows, key=lambda x:x[0], reverse=True)
print('playlist_durations_minutes_exact')
for total_minutes, pl_id, title, song_count, total_seconds in rows_sorted:
    print({'playlist_id':pl_id,'title':title,'song_count':song_count,'minutes_exact':total_minutes,'minutes_rounded':int(math.floor(total_minutes+0.5)),'seconds_total':total_seconds})

max_minutes=rows_sorted[0][0]
rounded=int(math.floor(max_minutes+0.5))
print('FINAL_ANSWER:', rounded)
